procedure: Create a disposable virtual environment and install the repository-declared .[dev] extra only.
expected_result: The isolated environment contains only the project editable install and transitive packages selected from declared development dependencies; no new dependency declaration is introduced.
limitations: Local validation used Python 3.12; repository CI independently validates the supported Python 3.11 configuration.
Package resolution follows the existing lower-bounded declarations and is not a lock-file claim.
